tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Deepest ground: map canvas, chart plot area, the space behind floating panels. `ink` and `ink-muted` read on this.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default page and panel background. `ink`, `ink-muted` and `ink-subtle` read on this.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, modals, sticky table headers, toolbars. `ink`, `ink-muted` and `ink-subtle` read on this.

tokens.name: surface-inset
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: table header strips, code blocks, disabled field grounds. `ink` and `ink-muted` read on this.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover ground for table rows, menu items and list rows over `surface` and `surface-raised`. `ink` reads on this.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative separation only: table row rules, panel dividers, grid lines. Never the edge of a control — it does not hold 3:1.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Edges that carry meaning: input, checkbox and secondary-button borders, chart axes, the required edge on a `fdr-*` chip. Holds 3:1 on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-inset` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-inset`, `surface-hover` and every `*-wash` token.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: field labels, units, captions, table column headers, on `canvas`, `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Lowest-emphasis text that must still be read: placeholders, axis tick labels, disabled labels, on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink-on-warm
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the light hazard fills: `fdr-no-rating`, `fdr-moderate`, `fdr-high`, `fdr-extreme`. Theme-independent, because the hazard fills are.

tokens.name: ink-on-deep
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the deep hazard fill `fdr-catastrophic`. Theme-independent.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one interactive accent: links, primary button fill, selected row, active tab. On `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: signal-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state for anything painted `signal`.

tokens.name: signal-wash
tokens.usage: Tint ground for selected rows, active filters and neutral notices. `ink` reads on this.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `signal` or `signal-hover` fill.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus indicator: a solid 2px ring, 2px offset. Holds 3:1 on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-inset` in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-ember
tokens.usage: Wordmark, cover and brand marks only. Never in application chrome: the warm spectrum belongs to hazard semantics.

tokens.name: fdr-no-rating
tokens.usage: AFDRS 'No Rating' fill, with `ink-on-warm` text and a `border` edge. Theme-independent. Reviewed and confirmed — see Hazard colour in the brand book.
tokens.provenanceNote: Confirmed correct by Ben Twomey (qualified FBAN), 8 October 2026, by inspection.

tokens.name: fdr-moderate
tokens.usage: AFDRS 'Moderate' fill, with `ink-on-warm` text and a `border` edge. Theme-independent. Reviewed and confirmed — see Hazard colour.
tokens.provenanceNote: Confirmed correct by Ben Twomey (qualified FBAN), 8 October 2026, by inspection.

tokens.name: fdr-high
tokens.usage: AFDRS 'High' fill, with `ink-on-warm` text and a `border` edge. Theme-independent. Reviewed and confirmed — see Hazard colour.
tokens.provenanceNote: Confirmed correct by Ben Twomey (qualified FBAN), 8 October 2026, by inspection.

tokens.name: fdr-extreme
tokens.usage: AFDRS 'Extreme' fill, with `ink-on-warm` text and a `border` edge. Theme-independent. Reviewed and confirmed — see Hazard colour.
tokens.provenanceNote: Confirmed correct by Ben Twomey (qualified FBAN), 8 October 2026, by inspection.

tokens.name: fdr-catastrophic
tokens.usage: AFDRS 'Catastrophic' fill, with `ink-on-deep` text and a `border` edge. Theme-independent. Reviewed and confirmed — see Hazard colour.
tokens.provenanceNote: Confirmed correct by Ben Twomey (qualified FBAN), 8 October 2026, by inspection.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Nominal, contained, pass. Icon or text colour on `surface` and `surface-raised`. Deliberately a teal (hue 172°), off the red–green axis toward blue, so it is not told apart from `status-danger` by hue alone; always carried with a word or icon as well.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Caution, degraded, stale or ageing data. Icon or text colour on `surface` and `surface-raised`; always beside a word. The dark step was moved off amber because the previous value sat ΔE 4.5 from `fdr-high` — the same yellow as the High band, in the same table row. Now ΔE 21.3.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Failure, threshold breach, uncontained, going — and under assessment, which is the same severity with crews sizing it up rather than suppressing. Colour is severity only; whether it is being actively suppressed is the `StatusBadge` dot fill. Icon or text colour on `surface` and `surface-raised`; also the destructive button fill with `on-status-danger`.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Neutral notice. Alias of `signal`, so a notice and a link never disagree.

tokens.name: on-status-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `status-danger` fill (the destructive button).

tokens.name: status-ok-wash
tokens.usage: Ground for a nominal banner or tile. `ink` reads on this.

tokens.name: status-warn-wash
tokens.usage: Ground for a caution banner or a stale-data tile. `ink` reads on this.

tokens.name: status-danger-wash
tokens.usage: Ground for a failure or threshold-breach banner. `ink` reads on this.

tokens.name: viz-1
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 1 (blue) — IDENTITY only, for series with no inherent order. Derived from Okabe & Ito, re-stepped per theme; one shared hue order so a series never changes colour between themes. Assign in order, never cycle, cap at 4 in one chart. Never inside the same visual region as an `fdr-*` chip — see Colour method.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dim behind modals and drawers, and over map imagery carrying panel text.

tokens.name: label-halo
tokens.usage: Halo behind labels drawn over map imagery or photography, so `ink` survives any basemap.

tokens.name: sev-0
tokens.usage: Severity step 0 of 5 (0 = lowest). SEQUENTIAL — encodes how much, one warm hue, monotone. The anchor flips by theme: on dark the high step is the brightest, on light it is the darkest, so the worst value is always the most prominent mark. Warm here means severity and agrees with the AFDRS direction of travel; it is not competing with it.

tokens.name: div-lo-0
tokens.usage: Diverging, below-baseline step 0 of 3 (0 = smallest departure). Cool arm. Prominence rises with the departure in both themes — brighter on dark, darker on light.

tokens.name: div-lo-1
tokens.usage: Diverging, below-baseline step 1 of 3 (0 = smallest departure). Cool arm. Prominence rises with the departure in both themes — brighter on dark, darker on light.

tokens.name: div-lo-2
tokens.usage: Diverging, below-baseline step 2 of 3 (0 = smallest departure). Cool arm. Prominence rises with the departure in both themes — brighter on dark, darker on light.

tokens.name: div-hi-0
tokens.usage: Diverging, above-baseline step 0 of 3 (0 = smallest departure). Warm arm, because above-normal is the worse direction for almost every fire metric.

tokens.name: div-hi-1
tokens.usage: Diverging, above-baseline step 1 of 3 (0 = smallest departure). Warm arm, because above-normal is the worse direction for almost every fire metric.

tokens.name: div-hi-2
tokens.usage: Diverging, above-baseline step 2 of 3 (0 = smallest departure). Warm arm, because above-normal is the worse direction for almost every fire metric.

tokens.name: div-mid
tokens.usage: Neutral midpoint of a diverging scale — the baseline itself. Grey by design: a hue here would imply the midpoint means something.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: EMPHASIS — the one mark on a screen that carries the finding. Paired with dimmed context (`ink-subtle` at 28%). This channel is stronger than hue and spends none of the colour budget; prefer it over adding a seventh series colour.

tokens.name: focus-wash
tokens.usage: Ground behind a focused region, and the stop colour for a focused area-chart gradient.

families.condensed: "IBM Plex Sans Condensed", "IBM Plex Sans", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Cover and landing headline, one per screen. Extra Light 200 with tight tracking — the weight that makes a large number feel measured rather than shouted.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page title.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Section heading, panel group title.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Lead paragraph in briefings and reports.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default running text. Every paragraph that is not a lead.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense text: table cells, list rows, help text. Weight 400, not 300 — nothing below 14px drops to Light on a dark ground, where thin strokes bloom and break up.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels and tile labels, in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Set in uppercase. Section eyebrow and badge text, in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Source lines, timestamps and provenance notes, in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: readout-xl
styles.usage: The one number a screen exists for. Mono keeps digits from shifting as it ticks.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Metric tile value.

styles.name: readout-sm
styles.usage: Secondary metric, in-table figure that must align down the column.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Coordinates, grid references, timestamps, callsigns, code.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Axis tick values, legend numbers, dense log lines.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Button and menu-item text.

styles.name: control-sm
styles.usage: Small button, chip and toolbar text.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Tab and segmented-control text; 600 when active.

styles.name: table-header
styles.usage: Set in uppercase. Column headers, so a 14-column table still fits a laptop.

styles.name: map-label
styles.usage: Labels drawn over a map, with a `label-halo` behind them.

styles.name: doc-body
styles.usage: Long-form print body, Plex Serif. 14px here is 10.5pt on the page — the token grammar takes px only, so print sizes are declared in their px equivalent.

styles.name: doc-lead
styles.usage: Opening paragraph of a report or proposal section.

styles.name: doc-note
styles.usage: Footnotes, source lines and figure captions in print.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Dense operational layouts live between space-1 and space-4; space-8 and up separate regions, never elements.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets: focus-ring offset, icon nudge.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; dense table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Default gap inside a control; small button padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding; gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel and card padding; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding in a roomy card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; panel header padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections within a page.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page gutter on a laptop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between major regions.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page top margin in a briefing document.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Map chrome, data table cells, anything that must tile flush.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, badges, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, metric tiles. The default.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, modals, floating map overlays.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and pill toggles only.

shadow.note: Dark surfaces separate by their own value first and shadow second; light surfaces rely on shadow. Never both a shadow and a border-hairline on the same edge.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting buttons and chips.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, popovers, hovered cards.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and drawers.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: A panel floating over a map: a hairline edge plus lift, so it survives any basemap.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls. Never applied to text that must still be read.

tokens.name: opacity-context-dim
tokens.usage: Emphasis charts: everything that is not the focus is drawn from ink-subtle at this opacity.

tokens.name: opacity-ghost
tokens.usage: Ghost-button hover ground, drawn from ink.

tokens.name: opacity-overlay
tokens.usage: Raster layer drawn over a basemap.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Borders, table rules, chart axes.

tokens.name: stroke-mark
tokens.usage: Focus rings, active tab underline, chart series lines, fire perimeter.

tokens.name: stroke-heavy
tokens.usage: Active fire edge, selected geometry, alert banner leading edge.

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: Map and document flow.

tokens.name: z-map-overlay
tokens.usage: Legends, scale bars and floating panels over a map.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers and toolbars.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modals, drawers and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-alert
tokens.usage: Warning banners that must never be covered.
